pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto aññatarassa kulassa kulūpako hoti niccabhattiko.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.3: yaṃ tasmiṃ kule uppajjati khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā tato āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa paṭiviso ṭhapito hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.4: tena kho pana samayena sāyaṃ tasmiṃ kule maṃsaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.5: tato āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa paṭiviso ṭhapito hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.6: tassa kulassa dārako rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya rodati maṃsaṃ me dethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.7: athakho so puriso pajāpatiṃ etadavoca ayyassa paṭivisaṃ dārakassa dehi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.9: athakho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena taṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.10: athakho so puriso yenāyasmā upanando sakyaputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.11: hiyyo kho bhante sāyaṃ maṃsaṃ uppannaṃ tato ayyassa paṭiviso ṭhapito
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.12: ayaṃ bhante dārako rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya rodati maṃsaṃ me dethāti ayyassa paṭiviso dārakassa dinno
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.17: athakho so puriso āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa kahāpaṇaṃ datvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti yatheva mayaṃ rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma evamevime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.18: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa purissa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.19: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.20: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto rūpiyaṃ paṭiggahessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.21: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.22: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ upananda rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāsīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.25: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa rūpiyaṃ paṭiggahessasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.26: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.27: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.28.1: yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.8: kahāpaṇo lohamāsako dārumāsako jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.14: idaṃ ayyassa hotūti upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyati nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.17: tena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.23: sace tattha āgacchati ārāmiko vā upāsako vā so vattabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.30: sappi vā telaṃ vā madhu vā phāṇitaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.31: sace so tena parivaṭṭetvā kappiyaṃ āharati rūpiyapaṭiggāhakaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbeheva paribhuñjitabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.36: no ce chaḍḍeti pañcahaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu rūpiyachaḍḍako sammannitabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.37: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya chaḍḍitāchaḍḍitañca jāneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.40: yācitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.42: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ rūpiyachaḍḍakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.46: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno rūpiyachaḍḍakassa sammati so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.51: tena sammatena bhikkhunā animittaṃ katvā pātetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.52: sace nimittaṃ katvā pāteti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.53.1: rūpiye rūpiyasaññī rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.54: rūpiye vematiko rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.55: rūpiye arūpiyasaññī rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.60: ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipati
